{{Disambig|Extra}}

==Enemies==
'''Extra''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Extra A]], a blue Extra enemy that first appears on Wave 4 in [[The Narratorium]] and can be spawned by the [[Extra B]] upon its death. 
**[[Extra A/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Extra B]], a green Extra enemy that first appears on Wave 7 in [[The Narratorium]], spawns the [[Extra A]] upon death and is spawned by the [[Extra C]] upon its death.
**[[Extra B/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Extra C]], a red Extra enemy that first appears on Wave 16 in [[The Narratorium]], spawns the [[Extra B]] upon death and is spawned by the [[Extra D]] upon its death.
*[[Extra D]], a purple Extra enemy that first appears on Wave 22 in [[The Narratorium]], spawns the [[Extra C]] upon death.
**[[Extra D/Advanced Stats]]
